channel.title: ABDITORY
channel.description: Custom-made gothic footwear and accessories, handmade in Tbilisi and shipped worldwide.

item.g:title: Gothic Armor-Plate Knee-High Platform Boots
item.g:description: Command attention with these industrial gothic knee-high boots featuring a dramatic 10cm platform heel. Designed for maximum visual impact, they showcase a ladder of multi-buckle straps accented with sleek rectangular metal plates along the shaft and vamp. Elevated on a towering 10cm solid platform base, these boots fuse heavy cyber-armor aesthetics with effortless alternative style.

item.g:title: Darkwave Heavy Spiked Multi-Buckle Platform Boots
item.g:description: Unleash pure gothic attitude with these knee-high industrial platform boots. Designed for maximum visual punch, they feature a full front lace-up panel overlaid with multiple studded buckle straps detailed with metallic skull accents and aggressive cone spikes. Built on a chunky platform sole capped with silver metal toe plates and side harness buckles, these boots combine extreme alternative aesthetic with full inner zippers for easy wear.

item.g:title: Heavy Metal Spiked Multi-Buckle Knee-High Boots
item.g:description: Elevate your alternative style with these heavy-duty gothic knee-high boots featuring a bold 11cm platform heel. Designed with a multi-buckle strap layout, metallic skull hardware, and sharp cone spikes along the shaft and vamp, these boots deliver uncompromising attitude. Set atop an 11cm chunky platform sole accented with metallic grommets and side skull buckles, they come complete with lace-up fronts, top O-ring pull tabs, and full inner zippers for easy wearing.

item.g:title: Gothic Skull & Crossbones Ankle Platform Boots
item.g:description: Command maximum alternative presence in these heavy-duty gothic ankle boots elevated on a 10cm platform heel. Detailed with metallic skull-and-crossbones hardware, silver studs, and sharp cone spikes around the ankle, vamp, and heel counter, these boots bring intense industrial energy. Set on a 10cm chunky platform sole wrapped with studded leather bands, skull plates, and metal spider charms, they feature lace-up fronts and full inner zippers for effortless wear.

item.g:title: Shadow-Realm Skull & Chain Mid-Top Platforms
item.g:description: Channel pure underground energy with these low-profile, high-impact sneakers set on a commanding 11cm platform heel. Blending sneaker-boot comfort with heavy metal aggression, they showcase a metallic skull-and-crossbones emblem emblazoned across the padded tongue, sharp lethal spikes framing the eyelets, and interlocking silver chains strung across the toe cap. The ultra-thick 11cm sculpted block sole is enveloped in a studded harness band decorated with metallic spider plaques and gunmetal side buckles—offering an untouchable darkwave aesthetic with every step.

item.g:title: Platforms with Chains & Spikes
item.g:description: Dominate the room in these industrial gothic platform boots. Built for heavy alternative style, they feature layers of spike-studded buckle straps wrapped in oversized silver chains. A thick, chunk platform base is detailed with metallic spider and scorpion emblems and wrapped buckle hardware, finished with an inner side zip for easy wear.

item.g:title: Fluffy Custom-Made Platforms
item.g:description: Bring maximalist edge to your look with these plush faux-fur platform boots. Built for bold alternative style, they wrap ultra-fluffy black faux fur in dramatic studded harness straps and fierce metallic cone spikes. Complete with heavy-duty buckles and an exaggerated platform base, they deliver instant attitude to any cyber-goth or rave ensemble.

item.g:title: Knee-High Gothic Platform Boots
item.g:description: Make an unforgettable statement with these knee-high gothic platform boots. Engineered for high-impact alternative style, they feature multi-buckle straps, metallic skull hardware, and sharp spike detailing. A thick studded platform sole is trimmed with hanging skull-and-spike charms, complete with front laces and an inner zipper for easy wearing.

item.g:title: Cybergoth Triple-Strap Wedge Platform Boots
item.g:description: Level up your streetwear game with these sleek cybergoth wedge platform boots. Combining a futuristic techwear silhouette with maximum height, they feature a multi-texture matte and padded upper secured by three heavy-duty hook-and-loop (Velcro) straps. Built on a massive sculpted wedge platform sole, they deliver pure darkwave attitude with effortless pull-on convenience.

item.g:title: High-Rise Matte Leather Platform Boots
item.g:description: Engineered for a commanding silhouette, these mid-calf boots blend bold architectural structure with clean, functional detailing. Crafted in a smooth matte black finish, the standout feature is a towering dual-tiered 15 cm continuous platform sole designed for maximum height and impact, finished with subtle base tread for added stability. The front lace-up closure is secured with polished silver-tone metal eyelets, perfectly complemented by fully functional exposed side zippers that allow for smooth, effortless wear. Featuring precise panel stitching and a defined mid-calf upper, this pair delivers an assertive, high-impact look without sacrificing structured support.

item.g:title: Contrast Panel Buckled Platform Slides
item.g:description: Designed with a heavy-duty aesthetic, these slip-on platform slides merge utility hardware with a dynamic two-tone construction. The upper features dual wide faux-leather straps secured by substantial, polished metallic buckles with engraved detail work and heavy eyelet accents. Built on a sculpted 13 cm wedge-style platform, the sole showcases a striking interplay of dark grey canvas texturing set against structured black overlays, finished with a deeply grooved rubber outsole for reliable grip and an assertive profile.

item.g:title: Patent Grommet Buckled Platform Boots
item.g:description: Crafted with a high-shine vinyl sheen, these ankle-length boots make an uncompromising statement through high-contrast materials and bold hardware elements. The glossy patent upper is enveloped by thick dual straps lined with silver-tone metal grommets and anchored by substantial double-prong roller buckles. Anchoring the design is a stacked, two-tone continuous 11 cm platform that transitions from a textured matte mid-band to a sleek, polished patent base, delivering an ultra-modern edge alongside substantial lift.

item.g:title: Spiked Harness Star Platform Boots
item.g:description: Combining extreme hardware with graphic detailing, these knee-high platform boots showcase a multi-textured construction with distinct alternative accents. The tall lace-up shaft is layered with skull-patterned side paneling and highlighted by silver contrast star appliqués extending across the upper and sole casing. Removable, trailing harness straps heavily studded with conical spikes wrap the calf and ankle, anchored by skull-embossed buckles. Resting on a massive, sculpted 13 cm wedge platform, this design offers maximum presence and high-impact structural detail.

item.g:title: Full-Spike Platform Mule Clogs
item.g:description: Engineered for extreme visual impact, these backless platform clogs deliver an uncompromising, aggressive design. Crafted from smooth black synthetic leather, the entire upper and continuous 10 cm platform base are densely studded with metallic cone spikes for a 360-degree tactical look. Featuring an easy slip-on silhouette, a padded footbed, and a deep wedge elevation, this pair merges bold industrial hardware with effortless wearable design.

item.g:title: Spiked Faux-Fur Harness Platform Boots
item.g:description: Striking a balance between tactile texture and heavy metal accents, these mid-calf boots are fully enveloped in a plush, grey-and-white mottled faux fur. The soft exterior is dramatically contrasted by dual leather shaft straps heavily loaded with sharp metallic cone spikes and trailing studded belts secured with ornamental buckles. A matching studded leather harness wraps around the foot and elevated 10 cm platform base, which is also trimmed in faux fur for a cohesive, polar-industrial statement piece.

item.g:title: Tactical Two-Tone Strapped Platform Sandals
item.g:description: Blending utility-inspired design with a clean, high-contrast palette, these open-toe platform sandals feature a durable, multi-strap upper crafted with adjustable hook-and-loop fasteners for a customized fit. The upper is anchored by a high-rise, sculpted 13 cm wedge platform that showcases a distinct paneling of muted purple canvas texture set against solid black suede-like overlays. Finished with a comfortable slingback heel strap and a serrated rubber tread, this pair delivers an effortless, streetwear-ready profile with maximum structural height.

item.g:title: Hardware-Laden Embellished Platform Slides
item.g:description: Defined by heavy metal hardware and gothic motifs, these open-toe platform slides deliver an intensely detailed, maximalist profile. The multi-strap upper combines conical spikes, metal track zips, curb-chain links, and polished silver studs alongside spade and spider charms. Wrapping around the continuous 10 cm wedge platform base is a harness-style leather band loaded with matching studs, skull buckles, and metallic appliqués, offering a bold 360-degree industrial look with high-impact elevation.

item.g:title: Multi-Buckle Heavy Hardware Knee-High Boots
item.g:description: Constructed with an intense industrial aesthetic, these tall knee-high boots present a heavily structured silhouette wrapped in functional hardware. A full front lace-up closure is layered with four wide, eyelet-punched leather straps featuring rectangular metallic buckles, complimented by hex-nut stud embellishments along the upper collar and vamp. The continuous 10 cm platform wedge sole is encased in a removable buckle-harness trim adorned with oversized metallic grommets and rounded studs, delivering a formidable presence with complete structural impact.

item.g:title: Spiked Belt-Accented Platform Mules
item.g:description: Defined by a minimal upper paired with sharp metallic hardware, these open-toe slide mules feature a padded black synthetic strap topped with a belted harness overlay. The decorative strap is studded with sharp conical spikes, metallic O-rings, and a polished silver buckle, creating an aggressive focal point against a clean silhouette. Set atop a smooth, seamless 10 cm wedge platform, this design combines easy slip-on convenience with a bold, dark aesthetic.

item.g:title: Shadow Fur Ring-Chained Platform Boots
item.g:description: Unleash high-impact industrial chaos with the Nightmare Hydra Platforms. Wrapped in hyper-dense, plush black faux fur, these extreme platform boots fuse raw texture with uncompromising metal accents. Featuring a 10 cm stacked platform elevation, the silhouette is heavily detailed with chained O-rings, spiked faux-leather strap harnesses, and a cascading triple-ring metal hardware layout across the toe. Engineered for the bold, these statement boots deliver maximum volume and dark alternative edge with every step.

item.g:title: Cryptic Skull Harness Platform Boots
item.g:description: Command any room with the Cryptic Skull Harness Platforms. Built with a commanding 10 cm platform sole, these boots are enveloped in ultra-plush black faux fur for an oversized, tactile silhouette. Four adjustable black faux-leather straps wrap across the front, secured with heavy-duty silver buckles, metal eyelets, and detailed skull emblems. Perfect for high-impact gothic and alternative styling, they deliver the ultimate blend of aggressive metal accents and volume.

item.g:title: Vanguard Contrast Harness Boots
item.g:description: Dominate the pavement with the Vanguard Contrast Harness Boots. Constructed from sleek matte black faux leather, these high-impact platform boots feature striking white contrast stitching that highlights every sharp edge and panel. Standing tall on a massive 12 cm block platform heel, the shaft is wrapped in multiple crisscrossing buckled straps, silver eyelets, and metallic studs across the front toe box. Finished with hardware-embellished cutouts on the massive platform sole and a crimson inner lining accent, these boots deliver an unyielding industrial silhouette built to turn heads

item.g:title: Subversion High-Top Canvas Platform Boots
item.g:description: Transform classic streetwear aesthetics into high-voltage alternative style with the Subversion High-Top Platforms. Built from durable black canvas with contrast white stitching, these knee-high sneaker boots feature a full front-lace design paired with crisp white laces and metal eyelets. The shaft is wrapped in five adjustable, grommeted buckle straps for an intense cyber-punk edge, while side zippers ensure effortless wear. Elevated on a striking 11 cm striped platform sole with a treaded bottom, these boots fuse skater heritage with raw industrial volume.

item.g:title: Obsidian Web Laced Patent Platforms
item.g:description: Make an unforgettable entrance with the Obsidian Web Laced Platforms. Crafted in high-gloss black patent leather, these extreme statement boots feature an extraordinary web-like cord configuration that wraps continuously across the entire upper, rounded toe box, block platform, and heel. Metallic D-ring lace hooks cover the entire silhouette from top to bottom, anchoring intricate speed-lacing detailing. Standing on a massive 16 cm elevated block heel with an inner side zipper for easy wear, these platform boots deliver ultra-sleek shine and complex structural drama.

item.g:title: Venom Skull Patent Platform High-Tops
item.g:description: Inject high-gloss rebellion into your rotation with the Venom Skull Patent Platforms. Styled in sleek, reflective black patent leather, these high-top sneaker platforms feature an oversized tongue emblazoned with a metallic 3D skull and crossbones emblem. An adjustable ankle strap studded with pyramid rivets locks in the fit, while classic lace-up detailing and crisp white toe caps add high-contrast definition. Set on a solid 8 cm multi-striped platform sole with a treaded base, these shoes blend streetwear energy with an unapologetic metal edge.

item.g:title: Widow's Web Arachnid Platform Sneakers
item.g:description: Infuse dark fantasy with high-impact hardware in the Widow's Web Platforms. Crafted from smooth black leatherette, these low-top platform sneakers sit atop an aggressive 11 cm sculpted platform sole heavily embellished with metallic skulls, ace spades, spiders, and side buckles. The upper is packed with intricate detailing—featuring sharp metallic spikes, skull-embossed straps, hanging silver spiderweb chains, and coffin charms. Topped with vibrant, glittering orange and hot pink spider accents perched on each tongue, these platforms blend macabre symbolism with bold, multi-textured alternative design.

item.g:title: Anarchy Spike Knee-High Platform Boots
item.g:description: Rule the underworld in the Anarchy Spike Knee-High Platforms. Crafted from premium smooth black leatherette, these towering boots are engineered with a commanding 12 cm studded block platform heel. The entire front lace-up closure is reinforced with heavy-duty metal lace hooks, topped with O-ring pulls at the collar. Five horizontal harness straps wrap the shaft, each armed with aggressive outward-facing metal spikes and detailed skull buckles. Finished with studded toe boxes, cross-adorned platform toe caps, and full-coverage spikes along the rear heel, this pair delivers maximum dystopian armor for your footwear collection.

item.g:title: Malice Skull Shield Platform Sneakers
item.g:description: Dominate the underground scene with the Malice Skull Shield Platforms. Crafted from smooth matte black faux leather, these chunky ankle-high sneaker platforms feature a dramatic fold-over tongue shield loaded with 3D metallic skull hardware and surroundingcone spikes. The 10 cm elevated platform base is completely wrapped in gothic hardware—boasting prominent skull emblems, sharp side studs, spiked front toe bumpers, and heavy metal buckles along the side harness. Designed for ultimate volume and dark industrial flair, these platform boots bring heavy metal attitude to every stride.

item.g:title: Phantom Web Corset Platform Boots
item.g:description: Command absolute authority with the Phantom Web Corset Platforms. Crafted in smooth matte black faux leather, these mid-calf statement boots feature an intricate web-lacing design that wraps completely around the 13 cm chunky platform base and heel block. Silver D-ring lace hooks cover the entire silhouette, securing crisscrossing cord details from toe to collar. Two heavy-duty, studded leatherette harness straps with oversized metallic buckles cinch the shaft, complemented by a spiked vamp harness and full-length inner side zippers for effortless wear.

item.g:title: Skullette Ribbon Canvas Platform Boots
item.g:description: Merge sweet rebellion with heavy metal contrast in the Skullette Ribbon Canvas Platforms. Crafted from durable black canvas with sharp white stitching, these knee-high sneaker boots feature high-contrast white front laces paired with a studded faux-leather bow accent clipped to the tongue. Multiple studded harness straps wrap the shaft, fitted with intricate skull-shaped metallic buckles and side skull studs. Standing on a 10 cm multi-layered platform sole, the base is wrapped in high-contrast skull and crossbones graphics for a playful yet dark ska-punk edge.

item.g:title: Vandal Spike Belted Canvas Platform Boots
item.g:description: Channel raw punk chaos with the Vandal Spike Belted Platforms. Constructed from deep black canvas with crisp white contrast stitching, these knee-high sneaker boots feature stark white front lacing and an 8 cm multi-striped platform sole. The design is heavily armored with long, trailing faux-leather belts densely studded with silver pyramid rivets, featuring an explosive fan of elongated metal spikes draped across the upper shaft. Finished with skull-engraved buckle straps over the vamp and an inner side zipper, these boots deliver maximum alternative aggression and visual volume.

item.g:title: Venomous Thorn Spiked Platform Sandals
item.g:description: Redefine dark warm-weather fashion with the Venomous Thorn Spiked Platform Sandals. Crafted from smooth black leatherette, these open-toe platform sandals feature an aggressive 10 cm sculpted platform sole completely wrapped in heavy-duty gothic hardware—including 3D skulls, metallic spider emblems, side buckles, and surrounding cone studs. The front toe strap is loaded with miniature skull studs and outward-facing spikes, while the wide midfoot arch strap is armed with dramatic, elongated metal thorns. An adjustable ankle buckle strap ensures a secure fit, making these sandals the ultimate combination of brutal hardware and breathable alternative style.

item.g:title: Grim Crossbearer Spiked Ankle Boots
item.g:description: Gear up for the end times with the Grim Crossbearer Spiked Boots. Cut from matte black leatherette, these heavy-duty ankle platform boots sit atop a chunky 10 cm platform base loaded with gothic hardware—including metallic cross emblems, spiders, side harness buckles, and studded accents. The shaft and vamp feature triple-tiered buckled straps fitted with detailed skull buckles, metallic cross rivets, and outward-projecting spikes. Complete with a heavily spiked toe cap and heel counter, these boots deliver unyielding dystopian armor for any alternative look.

item.g:title: Necro-Spike Cutout Platform Mules
item.g:description: Exude dramatic industrial flair with the Necro-Spike Cutout Platforms. Crafted from smooth matte black faux leather, these open-vamp platform mules feature double buckled top straps adorned with row upon row of fierce silver cone spikes. Metallic O-rings highlight the front toe cutouts, while an adjustable slingback ankle strap keeps the fit secure. Grounded by a massive 13 cm wedge platform sole with aggressive deep-lug treads, these shoes fuse sleek cutouts with brutal alternative hardware.

item.g:title: Cyber Armor Open-Toe Platform Boots
item.g:description: Command the room with the Cyber Armor Open-Toe Platforms. Crafted from smooth matte black faux leather, these open-toe, cage-style ankle boots combine cutout ventilation with heavy-duty metal hardware. The shaft and vamp are wrapped in four adjustable buckle straps featuring metallic plates armed with sharp cone spikes and O-ring pull tabs at the collar. Standing on a massive 10 cm sculpted platform sole adorned with metallic front toe plates, side buckles, and spider hardware, these platform boots deliver futuristic industrial aggression for your dark aesthetic.

item.g:title: Void Runner Techwear Platform Sandals
item.g:description: Fuse brutalist volume with tactical utility in the Void Runner Techwear Platforms. Crafted from deep black canvas and high-grade nylon, these open-toe platform sandals feature a triple-strap upper secured with matte black adjustable hook-and-loop utility buckles. A padded ankle harness delivers structural support, while the massive 13 cm sculpted wedge platform base provides extreme height with a clean, monochrome profile. Finished with a heavy-duty lugged tread, these platforms offer the ultimate futuristic street-tech silhouette.

item.g:title: Gargoyle Sculpted Open-Toe Platform Boots
item.g:description: Elevate dark gothic glamour with the Gargoyle Sculpted Open-Toe Platforms. Constructed from smooth black leatherette, these open-toe ankle boots feature bold geometric side cutouts paired with an intricate quadrupled strap closure. Each strap is anchored by ornate, metallic gargoyle-motif dragon buckles that add an exquisite metalwork focus across the front. Elevated on a towering 12 cm sculpted wedge platform base, these statement boots include a convenient inner side zipper and double pull tabs for high-impact alternative styling.

item.g:title: Frostbite Faux-Fur Spiked Platform Mules
item.g:description: Fuse tactile luxury with aggressive industrial hardware in the Frostbite Faux-Fur Spiked Platforms. Wrapped in plush, pitch-black faux fur across the entire upper and massive 12 cm platform base, these slip-on mules feature a wide, spiked faux-leather strap across the vamp loaded with silver cone studs and central cross emblems. An ornate metallic Western-style buckle embellishes the upper ankle, while a studded leather harness wraps around the plush sole—detailed with metallic spiders, ace spades, and side buckles. These mules offer a dramatic balance of soft texture and heavy metal edge.

item.g:title: Sacred Heart Spiked Chime Platform Mary Janes
item.g:description: Blend gothic romance with heavy metal subversion in the Sacred Heart Spiked Chime Platforms. Crafted from smooth matte black faux leather, these exaggerated Mary Jane platform heels feature an ankle harness strap with silver buckles, metal eyelets, and draped side chains that hang down to the sole. The massive front platform is detailed with a studded heart cutout motif on the side, a vertical row of sharp cone spikes along the front seam, and a buckled rear heel strap. Grounded on a dramatic 13 cm block heel, these shoes deliver a dark, romantic silhouette with sharp industrial edge.

item.g:title: FUCK OFF Spiked Platform Slides
item.g:description: Make an uncompromising statement with the FUCK OFF Spiked Platform Slides. Crafted from smooth matte black faux leather, these slip-on platform slides feature a wide vamp strap anchored by a studded harness band and an aggressive cluster of outward-facing silver spikes. The massive 10 cm wedge platform base takes rebellious design to the extreme, with metallic cone studs meticulously arranged along the lateral sides to spell out "FUCK OFF." Combining easy slide-on convenience with raw punk hostility, these platforms are built for maximum attitude.

item.g:title: FUCK OFF Spiked Platform Combat Boots
item.g:description: Unleash pure hostility and extreme height with the FUCK OFF Spiked Platform Combat Boots. Crafted from smooth matte black faux leather with high-contrast white topstitching, these mid-calf lace-up boots feature silver metallic eyelets and a back pull tab. The monolithic, towering 20 cm wedge platform base commands immediate attention, heavily studded on the lateral sides with sharp metallic cone studs that spell out "FUCK OFF." Engineered for maximum visual impact and unyielding punk attitude, these boots deliver an undeniable subcultural statement.
